_comment: Lab plan rules and defaults (see openspec/changes/easy-db-lab-plan). Rules pick at most max_scenarios scenarios: highest priority first, then most changed lines covered. Prefixes are relative to src/java/org/apache/cassandra/.

accord.title: Accord transactions against LWT
accord.hypothesis: the changed Accord code keeps or improves TxnCounter throughput and p99 against the merge-base, with no new errors, and the LWT control (a path the change does not touch) stays within the calibration spread

lwt.title: LWT contention
lwt.hypothesis: the changed Paxos or conditional-statement code keeps LWT throughput and p99 under contention at or better than the merge-base

compaction.title: compaction under write load
compaction.hypothesis: the changed compaction code keeps write throughput, pending compactions, bytes compacted and disk use at or better than the merge-base

write-path.title: write path and memtable
write-path.hypothesis: the changed write-path code keeps write throughput, GC pause and flush behaviour at or better than the merge-base

read-path.title: read path
read-path.hypothesis: the changed read-path code keeps read p50 and p99 and cache hit rate at or better than the merge-base

index.title: secondary index (SAI) queries
index.hypothesis: the changed index code keeps SAI query p99 and index build time at or better than the merge-base

mixed-load.title: mixed read and write load
mixed-load.hypothesis: the changed shared utility code keeps throughput, p99, GC and thread-pool pending counts at or better than the merge-base

repair.title: repair and streaming
repair.hypothesis: the changed repair or streaming code repairs a node that was down for 10 minutes in the same time or faster than the merge-base, with the same streamed bytes and no extra errors

mixed-version.title: mixed-version ring
mixed-version.hypothesis: a ring with one node on the PR build and the rest on the merge-base serves traffic with no errors, schema agreement and all nodes UN, and still does after the rest are upgraded

smoke.title: smoke test on the PR build
smoke.hypothesis: the PR build starts, serves traffic, and the changed feature works
